Method of Attack: Usage of a dropper component that scouts infected devices and delivers appropriate ransomware payload
Dropper performs device checks (rooted or not) and either locks screen with ransom 2D barcode or requests admin rights to install ransomware as system app
Ransomware remounts /system partition, copies embedded APK to /system/app, changes permissions, reboots device to run on boot-up
Ransomware locks device with 2D barcode ransom note, difficult to remove without reflashing device
Attack Vector: Booby-trapped Android apps spread through third-party app stores and download links sent via SMS and forum spam
Indicators of Compromise: 2D barcode ransom note displayed on infected device screen
Malicious APK installed in /system/app on rooted devices
Dropper hidden in malicious Android apps
